verdict: Muslim Subscription Box campaign is delivering roughly $5 back for every $1 spent this period.
diagnosis: $1,534 in ad spend drove $7,826 in tracked purchase value and 544 purchases, but recent review ratings averaged only 3 stars.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend near 5.1x
signals.detail: The Muslim Box campaign generated $7,826 in purchase value on $1,534 spend. Well above the DTC food category norm.

signals.headline: Cost per lead sits around $4
signals.detail: 198 leads at roughly $4 each is far below the $27 median for Facebook lead campaigns this year.

signals.headline: Only 42% of carts reached checkout
signals.detail: 172 add-to-carts produced 72 checkouts. A meaningful drop-off worth investigating on the product page or shipping step.

signals.headline: Latest review rating dropped to 3 stars
signals.detail: Recent reviews averaged 3 out of 5. Fresh negative feedback can quietly cap paid conversion rates over time.

signals.headline: Instagram added 92 followers
signals.detail: Follower growth is modest at 6,632 total. Engagement on media hit 679 interactions, so content is landing with the existing base.

recommendations.title: Investigate the cart-to-checkout drop-off
recommendations.detail: Consider auditing the checkout flow on mobile. 100 shoppers added to cart but never started checkout this period. Fixing friction here could lift purchases without more spend.

recommendations.title: Respond to recent 3-star reviews publicly
recommendations.detail: Worth replying to the latest reviews and asking happy subscribers for fresh ratings. Rating recovery protects both paid conversion and local search visibility.

recommendations.title: Test a summer grilling creative angle
recommendations.detail: Consider running one ad variant framed around rising grocery meat prices and subscription savings. Timely messaging often outperforms evergreen awareness creative during peak grilling months.
